_meta.title: One attachment over the per-attachment cap, alongside a small one
_meta.expect: The MESSAGE still threads (204, one row) and the over-cap attachment is DROPPED - fileRef=null, scanStatus=skipped, rejected=true, rejectReason=too_large - while the small sibling is stored normally. Interpretation note: only the TOTAL-delivery cap refuses a whole delivery; an over-cap attachment must not discard the human reply that carried it (rationale in inbound/intake.ts).
